verdict.rationale: Asana's own docs cite first-party automation features: rules and rule actions, AI Studio 'no-code automations', and AI Teammates/agents that work inside workflows under governance controls. However, the evidence is marketing-level and never documents how these automations trigger, schedule, or run unattended in the background; third-party tools like Zapier and n8n earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of trigger/schedule mechanics for background execution, evidence of AI Studio or agents acting autonomously without user prompting, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automate tedious work in powerful, bespoke ways with our platform features like rule actions, webhooks, and our API.
